card.name: Words just before material or make
card.fires_on: Small words like "to", "high", "organic" or "genetic" in general science text, where the next word is likely a thing being made or its material, such as "form", "make", "material" or "amount".

modes.label: "to" before make or form
modes.description: The word "to" after a noun, introducing what something produces or builds.
modes.example: a heavy substance sinking<< to>> form the earth. |The Nei

modes.label: Adjective before material
modes.description: An adjective that precedes a noun like material, carbon or nutrients.
